action_families.tax_revenue_or_rent_capture: Use for taxes, levies, surcharges, tariffs, excises, rent capture, broad revenue, and compensable harm pricing.
action_families.user_fee_or_service_charge: Use for fees or service charges requiring cost/value/special-benefit nexus and access protections.
action_families.rebate_credit_or_compensation: Use for credits, rebates, refunds, allowances, benefit accounts, vouchers, compensation, and make-whole repair.
action_families.mandate_standard_or_duty: Use for standards, duties, procurement/eligibility conditions, or behavioral requirements where price alone is not enough.
action_families.prohibition_no_go_or_veto: Use for injunctions, no-go rules, siting vetoes, bans, or non-compensable/catastrophic risk gates.
action_families.public_option_or_fallback_channel: Use for public or no-rent alternatives to private rails and essential channels.
action_families.penalty_liability_or_enforcement: Use for fines, penalties, forfeiture, enforcement, sanctions, preparer penalties, and liability allocation.
action_families.information_reporting_or_recordkeeping: Use for reports, registries, source records, disclosures, prefill, withholding maps, and machine-readable correction.
action_families.risk_prefunding_or_insurance_pool: Use for bonding, reserves, premiums, reinsurance, public backstops, and catastrophe/systemic risk prefunding.
action_families.subsidy_procurement_or_public_upside: Use for grants, procurement, public equity, subsidies, public research, and reciprocal public upside conditions.
action_families.source_release_integrity: Use for source hierarchy, scorecard, manifest, currentness, case-contract, and release-block actions.
action_families.classification_review_or_safe_harbor: Use when the central action is status correction, routing, safe harbor, or anti-arbitrage classification.
action_families.administrative_access_or_contest: Use when the action protects filing, payment, refund, appeal, service, hardship, record correction, or contest access.

special_rules: Profiles with action_family=user_fee_or_service_charge must name benefit_nexus as cost_value_special_benefit or explicit_statutory_fee_authority.
Profiles with fee-like instruments must block general-revenue fee laundering unless the action family is not primarily fee-like.
Profiles with no-go, injunction, veto, or non-compensable harm semantics must block priced permission.
Every profile must link to a remedy profile for the same route and mirror source_currentness_refs.
